optimizedContext.value:
# Symbol Model

## Rules
- `FileNode`: canonical forward-slash `{workspace}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` `path`; project-relative diagnostic path; language, content hash, workspace, optional deferred embedding. Equality by `path`. Optional `namespace` plus `namespaceSeparator` occur together, survive hydration, and do not affect equality.
- `SpecNode`: identity `specId`; path, title, description, artifact-derived content/hash, ordered `dependsOn`, workspace. Equality by `specId`.
- `SymbolNode`: deterministic `filePath + kind + name + line + column` identity; canonical file path, project-relative path, full construct range, exact `selectionRange`, optional comment. Ranges use 1-based lines and 0-based half-open columns; construct non-empty and contains selection.
- Specs, Files, Symbols, Documents use workspace-qualified canonical primary identities.
- Immutable runtime `FileAnalysisDraft`, `FileAnalysis`, `ParserState`, `AdapterSessionState` carry symbols, imports, deterministic binding/call facts, namespace context, normalized metadata, run-local identity, and only compact reusable parser/cache data. Distinct from persistence; no persisted ID/schema changes.
- Run-scoped lookup contract supports files by canonical path/run ID; symbols by file/simple/qualified name; file↔symbol; specs/documents; spec↔covered symbol; pre-persistence relation deduplication. `IndexSession` and `SymbolIndex` may collaborate internally.
- Retained parser/session state, facts, imports, and indexes use plain immutable data; never retain AST nodes, parser trees, cursors, or equivalent heavyweight artifacts after per-file analysis.
- `DocumentNode`: searchable non-code text with file-format identity, including reserved `root:`.
- Closed `SymbolKind`: `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`, `property`. File/module state→Variable without `parentId`; routine-local state→Variable with routine `parentId`; container state→Property with container `parentId`.
- Closed `RelationType`: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Relation equality = source+target+type.
- Hierarchy normalization: type→ancestor `EXTENDS`; type→contract `IMPLEMENTS`; replacing/concretizing/fulfilling method→base or contract method `OVERRIDES`. Useful language inheritance-adjacent constructs may normalize conservatively.
- `ImportDeclaration`: local/original names, raw specifier, relative flag, optional kind. Side-effect, dynamic, require, and Go blank imports use empty names and create no fake symbols; resolution occurs later.
- Immutable scoped facts represent scope ownership; source-aware bindings; local, parameter, property, class-managed, inherited, global, imported, framework, constructor, and known-alias sources; free/member/static/constructor calls; caller; deterministic resolution evidence. Scope cycles abort lookup.
- Deterministic facts emit persisted `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Resolved constructor/type annotations emit corresponding relations. Drop self-relations; unresolved facts remain non-persisted diagnostics only. No runtime/reflection/container/interprocedural/whole-program guessing.
- All model/aggregate properties `readonly`; graph mutation only through atomic `GraphStore` replacement.
- `SpecdCodeGraphError extends SpecdError`; package errors: `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `StoreNotOpenError`.
- Logical symbol differs from physical declaration. Language-proven overload/merge/augmentation may group declarations; competing declarations stay distinct. Structured workspace, surface, canonical logical owner, symbol space, simple name, `MemberSemantics`, and escaped versioned canonical reference are authoritative. Canonical reference includes semantic axes, round-trips, survives location movement, and rejects retired single-form encoding.
- Owned logical symbol stores exact dotted `qualified_name`; top-level omits it. `qualified_name` is not canonical ID, alias row, simple-name replacement, or FTS exact-match surrogate; `::` queries compare as dotted spelling.
- Logical identity carries no package name. `SymbolKind` remains broad; symbol space and member semantics are independent axes. Namespace/module is owner-path role and surface, not `SymbolKind`.
- `declaringOwner` is canonical logical owner, never parser/location/display ID. Adapter establishes owner before members and emits lexical occurrence `parentId`; shared model has no language list. Same-name members under different owners never share identity.
- Three non-bijective layers: physical location-backed `SymbolNode`; scope/range-preserving `LocalBinding`; semantic `LogicalSymbol`. Parameters, receivers, aliases, locals remain bindings unless proven addressable. Unmapped physical declarations remain navigation/dependency evidence.
- Multiple declarations share logical identity only with positive language-defined grouping evidence; absent/empty/unknown key never groups. Logical target retains deterministic declaration set; signature versus implementation does not split proven group.
- `MemberSemantics` combines `kind`, `dispatch`, `accessor`, optional `nativeKind`; retired `MemberForm` absent from symbols, resolver inputs, lookups, and persistence. Preserve type/value/namespace-module/property spaces and language-sensitive case; never globally lowercase or collapse differing axes.
- Public binding slot = surface+exported name+symbol space. Each target or ordered re-export route has distinct binding identity, including default/anonymous exports; never choose first same-name workspace symbol. Local bindings preserve scope/range; aliases, shadowing, competing routes/targets never collapse through metadata-insensitive relation equality.
- Physical dependency and hierarchy relations remain authoritative evidence. Logical projection may aggregate but retains every declaration, relation, and source location. Results/counts label physical occurrences versus logical targets; unmapped declarations remain declaration-only evidence.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` targets `LogicalSymbol.id`; physical traversal projects to logical identity while retaining declaration locations. Persist per-file/package coverage state and indexed hash for indexed, excluded, unsupported adapter/capability, parse-failed, and partial inputs.

## Constraints
- Structural value equality except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`.
- Adding `SymbolKind` or `RelationType` requires spec change.
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`.
- `FileNode.embedding` deferred until embedding pipeline.
- `COVERS_FILE` and `COVERS_SYMBOL` vocabulary exists but v1.5/v2 processes do not populate it.
- v1.5 indexer populates `DEPENDS_ON` from `.specd-metadata.yaml` or `spec.md`.
- v2 persists `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` for supported languages.
